example_prompt: Resend the Cartflox webhook delivery cmu8d4e5f0003abc now that my endpoint is fixed.

id.description: Webhook delivery identifier. Passed as a path parameter.

last_status_code.description: HTTP status of the last attempt.

response_ms.description: Duration of the last attempt, in milliseconds.

livemode.description: `true` for a production object, `false` for a test object: created with a test key, or in a workspace not switched live yet. Verify webhook signatures with the secret key of the same mode.

error_schema.description: Error body. `code` is present on transfer endpoints.

gotchas: Sends the delivery again right away, whatever its state (delivered, failed or pending), with a fresh signature, to the current webhook URL, and returns it updated: your handler receives the event again, so it must be idempotent.
404 when the delivery does not belong to the workspace, or belongs to the other mode (test vs production key).
Rate limit: 30 resends per minute per workspace (429 code rate_limited).

Errors are an HTTP 4xx/5xx status with a JSON body { "error": "<message>" }. Transfer endpoints add a machine-readable code, and so do some other refusals (code test_mode on payment links, rate_limited on webhook resends). A 401 says Missing API key or Invalid API Key.

spans: Sends the delivery again right away, whatever its state (delivered, failed or pending),
with a fresh signature, to the current URL of the workspace, and returns it updated.
`404` when it does not belong to the workspace (or to the other mode).
More than 30 resends per minute for this workspace (`code: rate_limited`).
Errors are reported by the HTTP status code and a JSON body `{ "error": "<message>" }`.
API key missing or invalid: `Missing API key` or `Invalid API Key`
